faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions regarding how the cooperative platform operates for customers and workers.
faq.a1: KaushalyaSetu is a digital cooperative services platform connecting households with skilled trade workers through registered cooperative societies and federations for home maintenance, repair, and community services.
faq.q2: How do I request a service?
faq.a2: Customers choose an essential trade service, provide task details and location, specify an appointment schedule, and submit their request to notify nearby eligible cooperative workers.
faq.q3: How are workers matched with my request?
faq.a3: The platform evaluates verified trade skills, live availability, geographic proximity, and active federation membership to match eligible cooperative workers within your local area.
faq.q4: Can I compare estimates from multiple workers?
faq.a4: Yes. Nearby eligible workers review your request and submit itemized estimates detailing labor and anticipated material costs, allowing you to compare and select the best estimate.
faq.a5: When the selected worker arrives at your location, a secure 4-digit one-time passcode (OTP) displayed on your booking screen must be entered by the worker to officially start the service.
faq.q6: How does billing and payment work?
faq.a6: Upon job completion, the worker generates an itemized final bill covering actual labor and materials. Customers review the breakdown and settle payment securely online with digital receipt generation.
faq.q7: How can a worker join KaushalyaSetu?
faq.a7: Skilled craftspeople can register through their local cooperative society by submitting their trade credentials, identity verification, and bank details for federation approval.
faq.q8: What role does the cooperative/federation play?
faq.a8: District cooperative federations verify and onboard workers, maintain member trade records, oversee service standards, support welfare initiatives, and handle dispute mediation.
faq.q9: What happens if there is a problem with a service?
faq.a9: Both customers and workers can file formal, booking-linked grievances through the platform. Disputes are reviewed and mediated by federation administrators, with escalation to Super Admin if needed.
